slides.title: What is agentic AI?
slides.say: Here, agentic AI means a model can choose a permitted next step using a tool's returned result. The important part is that the result can change the next choice. The model still works within limits set by the application. In our default lab, Python runs now while the Llama choices come from saved recordings.

slides.title: A tool call and an agent workflow
slides.say: A tool call is one job, such as calculating a power flow. A workflow connects several jobs. In an agentic step, the model helps choose what happens next. A fixed program can also contain loops and checks, so a loop alone does not make a system agentic. Look for the actual model decision.
